lines: Revenue was $114.4 million, up 11% year over year; exome and genome revenue was $100.3 million, up 17%.
Exome and genome result volume was 30,785 tests, up 32% year over year.
GAAP gross margin was 68%; adjusted gross margin was 70%. GAAP net loss was $17.7 million and adjusted net income was $0.4 million.
GeneDx reaffirmed full-year 2026 revenue guidance of $475-$490 million with at least 30% exome/genome volume growth and positive adjusted net income.
